note: Grand River access, half open farmland and half timber, with two primitive camping spots at lots on Route H; no boat ramp - small boats and canoes are lowered down the bank. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: two MDC-designated primitive camping spots at the two lots on Route H (527 m apart), free, FCFS, no hookups. Pin on the south spot. Not waterfront confirmed: the north spot is ~35-45 m from the Grand River through continuous trees.
flags: INCLUSION/FIT: the area page lists 'Individual Campsites'; the 2009 area map shows a Primitive Camping Area symbol beside each of its two parking lots on Route H, and MDC GIS has two camping points: 40.09302,-94.35036 (the stored pin, 21 m from the south lot) and 40.09769,-94.35143 (30 m from the north lot, by the river). Both are small pull-offs straight off Route H (GIS 'Paved' lots; the south one ~27 x 22 m, the north ~16 x 16 m), drive-in for a 23-ft rig, no ford. They are MDC-designated camping, though in practice the camping is at the lots.

WATERFRONT (stored not waterfront): confirmed. The Grand River (~40-50 m wide here) is ~35-45 m from the north spot, but through a continuous wooded bank on summer imagery, and the area page says boats 'must be lowered down river bank' - no open apron, no confirmed view. The south spot (the pin) is ~500 m from the river. Possible riverview from the north spot in leaf-off months only - not enough.
Pin is the south camping point - fine.
